questions.subject: DISCRETE_MATHEMATICS_II
questions.learningObjective: Solve an exam-level problem in discrete mathematics from first principles.
questions.stem: How many rows are in a truth table with 6 variables?
questions.explanation: Each of the 6 Boolean variables can be true or false, so there are 2^6=64 distinct assignments. Doubling n would count only 2n rows.
questions.hint: Each variable doubles the number of rows.
